text:
lia: dropped a new mock for an inline streaming toolbar. Key differences: (1) tiny Stop (primary) + Regenerate (secondary) with an optional confirm for Regenerate on long streams, (2) compact token badge that shows only delta while streaming (e.g. "+45") and expands to "sent / limit" on hover, (3) prompt library slides in as a side panel (push on desktop, overlay on mobile). PNG attached. quick takes? kevin: love the compact token delta idea. Less noise in the UI. Confirm for Regenerate seems heavy — can we make it conditional (only show confirm if stream > 12s or tokens > 1500)? maria: conditional confirm is smart. product-wise, when users hit Regenerate we should surface what changed (edited prompt vs same prompt) in a tiny toast: "Generating a fresh reply from the same prompt" vs "Generating with your edits". small affordance but helpful. jon: accessibility notes: icon-only buttons need explicit aria-labels. For live streaming container use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="false". Also, avoid continuously updating the accessible name for the token badge; update it only on significant jumps or when the region receives focus. snippet:```html
...chunks...
``` emily: keyboard shortcuts: Esc to stop, Shift+Cmd+R to regenerate (avoid Cmd+R conflict with browser reload). Also propose Alt+T to toggle token display expansion. We'll document these in the shortcuts modal. tasha: infra: per-chunk telemetry is our enemy here. Recommend the UI emit token updates at 250ms throttle and sample full events for long streams (>30s) at 10% to keep costs sane. We'll also add a guard for streams that exceed token budget to avoid spikes. kevin: copy tweaks: visible button labels should stay short: "Stop", "Regenerate". Add aria-labels like "Stop generation (Esc)" and tooltip explaining confirm behavior: "Regenerate will create a new reply from the same prompt (confirm required for long outputs)". maria: prompt library behavior: pushing the chat column on desktop is my preference — keeps context. But ensure when the panel opens the active stream keeps pinned-bottom behavior and we don't jump the viewport. Consider animating the push so users keep place. jon: token delta microcopy idea: show "+45" while streaming, and when the user hovers expand to "45 sent · 4096 limit". For screen readers, expose: "Tokens sent: 45 of 4096" but only announce on user focus. lia: experiment plan suggestion: run a week-long canary with the feature-flagged compact toolbar on 5% of web traffic. Collect metrics: regen_confirm_rate, accidental_regen_reports, stop_rate, avg_stream_tokens, token_update_events_per_session. emily: add metrics for keyboard usage: percent_stop_via_key, percent_regen_via_key. good to know if shortcuts reduce accidental clicks. tasha: engineering PR checklist: tokenUpdateThrottleMs: 250, regenConfirmThresholdMs: 12000, sampleLongStreamsPct: 10. Add server-side guard to drop verbose telemetry if the stream is noisy. kevin: UI props: allowConfirmOnRegenerate: boolean, regenerateConfirmThresholdMs: number, tokenDisplayMode: "delta"|"full", tokenUpdateThrottleMs: number. I'll sketch the component API in the HIG. maria: accessibility acceptance: 1) all action buttons have aria-label and tooltip, 2) streaming container aria-live polite + aria-atomic false, 3) token badge not auto-announcing every chunk, 4) keyboard shortcuts documented + discoverable in modal. lia: rollout notes: feature flag "compact_stream_toolbar", canary 5% web next week, full experiment after one week if metrics look good. I'll file the AB ticket and attach mocks + acceptance criteria. \ deploy-bot: FYI: staging deploy with compact_toolbar feature flag scheduled Thu 08:00 PDT; canary toggles available. lia: thanks all 44d i'll create the ticket and ping eng/design for final reviews. :white_check_mark:
